fnol_text: My name is Owen Quinlan and I live at 775 Rowan Way, Clinton, NC 28325. You can reach me on (555) 503-3652 or owen.quinlan@example.com. There was a flood warning for our area from the day before, but I left the car parked on the street by the river. On 29 September 2026 the water rose and the car was flooded up to the seats. Policy MT-2023-00026. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Quinlan on (555) 503-3652 to acknowledge the claim. Owen confirmed the loss date as 29 September 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Owen O'Connell gave a statement by phone.
Owen sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
